archetypes.name: dyn-hook-fd
archetypes.rationale: fd-bound hook state mutation is the core risk surface.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the anti-read-poll Python helper and Bash wrapper for any remaining path-based mutation or symlink-following edge cases. Focus on temp-root opening, state directory creation, leaf replacement, fail-open behavior, and whether non-Read payloads avoid filesystem state entirely. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
